_meta.description: Lender registry: licence/registration status + regulator findings. Each fact carries a source and date. Facts only, no unsourced accusations. This is a demonstration pack showing that Deni's Kenya model ports to another country by swapping data; it is lighter than the Kenya pack and figures are illustrative.
_meta.ncr_note: In South Africa, credit providers must be registered with the National Credit Regulator (NCR) under the National Credit Act 34 of 2005. This is the analogue of Kenya's CBK licensing.

licence_authority.register_url_todo: Point at the NCR's public 'registered credit providers' search/list page rather than the NCR homepage.
licence_authority.registered_note: is registered with the National Credit Regulator under the National Credit Act (verify current status at ncr.org.za).
licence_authority.unregistered_note: is not registered with the NCR. Providing credit without NCR registration is unlawful, and such credit's enforceability is challengeable.
licence_authority.not_applicable_note: is not an NCR-registered credit provider under this regime.
licence_authority.examples: e.g. a bank, a vehicle financier, QuickRand

reported_concerns.summary: The Act prohibits reckless credit granting and requires credit providers to be registered; an unregistered provider operates unlawfully. General statute, not a finding against this specific demo lender.
